name: zvideo_restore_iconic_fullscreen_window
description: zVideo_RestoreIconicFullscreenWindowIfNeeded restores an iconic fullscreen video window only when video is initialized and fullscreen is enabled.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly validates checks for initialized video and fullscreen option before IsIconic/OpenIcon on g_zVideo_hWnd.
The native smoke verifies an iconic fullscreen window is restored and that the fullscreen-disabled path skips restoration.
